Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this Custom Football Bedding Set from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and teams, this bedding set features a cool footballer design running with a ball. research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your space with the Custom Footballer on Fire Comforter Set from Jeminise, designed to bring the vibrant spirit of the game into your bedroom. Perfect for sports fans, players, and coaches, this custom bedding set offers an eye-catching design paired with cozy, breathable warmth. Whether you are looking for a lightweight duvet cover or an all-in-one comforter, this bedding serves as a stylish sports-themed decor piece and a thoughtful personalized gift for birthdays, holidays, or special celebrations.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customization options are supported with 2 text inputs, allowing you to personalize the bedding with a name and number.
  • Premium Material Details: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, lightweight, and durable texture.
  • Cozy Comforter & Duvet Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure (no insert included) or a thick, all-in-one comforter with a warm, non-clumping microfiber fill.
  • Included Components: Each package features 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) and optional matching sports pillowcases to complete the theme.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for US beds, including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Material Polyester
Fabric Type Brushed Polyester
Selected Design Footballer on Fire
Theme Football / Sports
Seasons All Seasons
Care Instructions Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Transform your bedroom into the ultimate football sanctuary with this custom football bedding set from Jeminise. Perfect for players, coaches, and dedicated fans, this set brings the spirit and passion of the game right into your personal space. Designed with a striking American football player silhouette against a patriotic flag backdrop, it adds an instant sporty touch to any kids' room, teen bedroom, or guestroom.

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your chosen name and player number for a truly unique look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric with a soft, whole-piece filling to prevent clumping and shifting.

  • Product Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a thicker, cozy comforter for all-season warmth.

  • Complete Set: Each package contains one main bedding cover (duvet or comforter) with optional matching pillowcases.

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate football sanctuary with this custom football bedding set from Jeminise. Perfect for players, coaches, and dedicated fans, this set brings the spirit and passion of the game right into your personal space. Designed with a striking American football player silhouette against a patriotic flag backdrop, it adds an instant sporty touch to any kids' room, teen bedroom, or guestroom.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your chosen name and player number for a truly unique look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric with a soft, whole-piece filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for various beds, including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Product Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a thicker, cozy comforter for all-season warmth.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry low or air dry without heat to keep the fabric fluffy and vibrant.
  • Complete Set: Each package contains one main bedding cover (duvet or comforter) with optional matching pillowcases.

Transform your space with this sport-themed bedding set by Jeminise, designed for football lovers, players, and fans. Featuring a cool digital illustration of an American football player with a burning ball, this comforter set adds a dynamic, athletic vibe to any bedroom. Whether you are looking for a lightweight duvet cover or an all-in-one cozy comforter, this customizable set is the perfect sporty addition to your home decor or a thoughtful gift for holidays and birthdays.

  • Bedding Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure (no filling included) or a cozy, all-in-one comforter with a soft microfiber filling.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, lightweight, durable, and comfortable sleep experience.
  • Optional Accessories: Complete your football-themed bedroom setup by adding matching optional pillowcases or an additional flat sheet cover.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Made using advanced environmental protection dyeing techniques that hold color to prevent fading, finished with fine, compact stitching along the edges.
  • Easy Care Instructions: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat or air dry to keep the microfiber soft and fluffy.
